summary: SUI Group Holdings filed an 8-K reporting results of its September 4, 2026 annual meeting. Of 76,802,872 shares entitled to vote, 25,698,781 (33.46%) were present, constituting a quorum. Shareholders re-elected six directors, approved executive compensation on a non-binding advisory basis, and approved issuance of 705,721 shares upon exercise of contingently issued non-employee director warrants under Nasdaq Rule 5635(c). The Minnesota-to-Delaware reincorporation proposal received insufficient votes and the meeting was adjourned as to that item. No special-situation transaction is present; routine meeting results only.
